decisions.rationale: First project reached day 2 (2026-06-08), so the team is active and technically engaged — webhook/payload detail in tick_22c846dc32c3 suggests real integration work. But no invite sent in 6 days and two unresolved tickets (badge issue reopened risk per email:54a1380f) are friction. 8 days left on a Team plan gives moderate odds.

draft.subject: Following up on your two open tickets
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks for flagging the webhook payload and timestamp question — that one's still open with support alongside the notification badge ticket, and I'm tracking both.

Separately, you've got your first project in Wrenfield, which is the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them. The natural next step is bringing a teammate in — a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through whatever's most useful.

Best,
Priya
